description: Parentheses around an OR are dropped from a DELETE.

base.purge.sql:
DELETE FROM sessions
WHERE user_id = $1 AND (expires_at < now() OR revoked);

head.purge.sql:
DELETE FROM sessions
WHERE user_id = $1 AND expires_at < now() OR revoked;

traps.why: AND binds first, so every user's revoked sessions are deleted.
